expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner centered over its hero image even though the image appears fully rendered behind it, suggesting a loading state that never resolves/dismisses.

The favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the ramen card's heart has a white circular background with a dark outline, while the pizza card's heart sits on a dark/translucent circle, creating a visual mismatch between identical controls.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are also missing they will be unusable with screen readers.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes a loading spinner remaining over content that has already loaded.
